_meta.purpose: Origin points for strategic disposition routing. The origin is the operator's local authority; distance to each facility is measured from here.
_meta.seeded_from: frontend/src/utils/sriLankaLocations.js -- the only set of Sri Lankan coordinates that already existed in this repository.
_meta.coordinate_source_file: frontend/src/utils/sriLankaLocations.js. KEEP THIS FILE. Every latitude/longitude below was copied from it, so it is the provenance for all 43 coordinates here, not dead code. The Disposition page no longer imports it (the selector now reads this register through GET /api/disposition/local-authorities, so the dashboard and the routing cannot hold diverging copies of the same numbers), which makes it look unused to a dependency check -- deleting it would strip the citation these coordinates rest on.
_meta.coordinates_policy: No coordinate here was invented. Every entry carries a coordinate copied from the repo gazetteer named in seeded_from. These are town-centre approximations, adequate for 'which plant is nearer' and not for logistics costing.
_meta.district_policy: district is standard Sri Lankan administrative geography, NOT data from this repo, and is descriptive only -- nothing in the routing reads it. Spot-check before publication.
_meta.TODO: This repository contains no authoritative register of Sri Lankan local authorities, so this list is the 43-town gazetteer above and nothing more. It is a town list, not a list of Municipal Councils / Urban Councils / Pradeshiya Sabhas. Any local authority an operator needs that is not named here must be added by hand with its own coordinate -- none has been guessed or back-filled. Entries also carry a town-centre point, not the authority's office.
